name: Dart Monkey
description: Throws inexpensive piercing darts. Its paths specialize in bouncing projectiles, temporary transformations, and long-range critical hits.

name: Boomerang Monkey
description: Throws returning projectiles that can hit several targets. Later paths favor ricochets, fast attacks, or MOAB-class knockback.

name: Bomb Shooter
description: Launches bombs that damage groups. Upgrades add stuns, anti-MOAB missiles, or repeated cluster explosions.

name: Tack Shooter
description: Fires radial volleys around its position. Paths add circular fire, activated blade barrages, or much denser tack fire.

name: Ice Monkey
description: Damages and freezes nearby ordinary Bloons. Upgrades add damage vulnerability, wider control, or anti-MOAB ice attacks.

name: Glue Gunner
description: Shoots non-damaging slowing glue at base. Its paths add corrosion, global damage-amplifying glue, or stronger crowd control.

name: Desperado
description: Fires paired pistol shots. Upgrades specialize in revolvers, a long-range rifle with support abilities, or close-range shotgun attacks.

name: Sniper Monkey
description: Shoots individual targets across the map when line of sight permits. Paths add MOAB control, bouncing shots and income, or automatic fire.

name: Monkey Sub
description: Fires homing darts from water. Upgrades add shared targeting range, submerged support, missiles, or faster dart attacks.

name: Monkey Buccaneer
description: Fires from a ship. Its paths add aircraft, cannon and harpoon attacks, or round-end trade income.

name: Monkey Ace
description: A plane follows a flight pattern and fires darts around itself. Paths add anti-MOAB weapons, bombs, or targeted high-volume fire.

name: Heli Pilot
description: A movable helicopter attacks near its current position. Paths add heavy weapons, transport and knockback, or supporting helicopters.

name: Mortar Monkey
description: Bombards a selected map position with area explosions. Paths add larger blasts, stuns and rapid bombardment, or property removal and burning.

name: Dartling Gunner
description: Fires continuously along a selected direction. Paths replace darts with beams, missiles, or multi-barrel buckshot.

name: Wizard Monkey
description: Fires magic projectiles. Paths add strong arcane attacks, fire and a Phoenix, or Camo removal and summoned Bloons.

name: Super Monkey
description: Fires darts at a very high rate. Paths add sacrifice-powered sun attacks, dual guns and an area ability, or dark attacks and teleportation.

name: Ninja Monkey
description: Throws shurikens and detects Camo without upgrades. Paths add many projectiles, Ninja support and sabotage, or anti-MOAB bombs.

name: Alchemist
description: Throws acid potions with splash and damage over time. Paths add tower buffs, explosive and transformation attacks, or extra income and shrinking.

name: Druid
description: Fires a spread of thorns. Paths add lightning and knockback, track vines and income, or attack bonuses that scale with combat conditions.

name: Mermonkey
description: Throws tridents with small splash attacks. Paths add an abyssal creature and support, cold attacks, or songs that redirect enemies.

name: Skywarden
description: Fires piercing arrows and gains attack speed through successful hits. Paths add distance-based attacks, electrical interactions, or freezing and shattering.

name: Banana Farm
description: Produces income instead of attacking. Paths favor collectible production, bank interest and cash abilities, or automatic cash collection.

name: Spike Factory
description: Places spike piles on nearby track. Paths add explosive mines, anti-MOAB spike storms, or longer-lived defensive piles.

name: Monkey Village
description: Buffs nearby towers' range without attacking at base. Paths add Primary support, detection and combat buffs, or discounts and income.

name: Engineer Monkey
description: Fires piercing nails. Paths add temporary sentries, cleansing and attack-speed support, or traps that capture enemies for cash.

name: Beast Handler
description: Uses a short-range staff before commanding a beast. Its paths command aquatic predators, land dinosaurs, or birds that reposition enemies.
